segments.title: Pre-Stream Crypto Investment Bit
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle workshop a crypto investment tip intro line before the gaming session begins.

segments.title: Lethal Company Co-op Session
segments.notes: Case hosts an extended Lethal Company co-op session with community players including Fiona, Exterminator, Miracle, America, Melko, and Griffin, failing to meet quota across multiple moons before raiding Avaly.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors an impromptu Lethal Company gaming session with community members, briefly attempting a crypto investment bit with Kendelle before extended co-op play.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Appears briefly pre-stream to workshop a crypto investment tip line with Case before he launches into gameplay.

lore_notes.fact: Case confirms his primary role is news anchoring, contrasting it with gaming streams.
Case mentions early editing work scheduled for the next day.
Raid attempt on Fiona blocked by her settings; Case raids Avaly instead.

episode_summary: Lead anchor Case Blackwell hosts a nearly two-hour Lethal Company co-op session with community players, cycling through multiple moons and failing to meet quota despite recovered apparatus and high-value scrap. The broadcast opens with a brief crypto investment bit alongside Kendelle before descending into extended gameplay marked by frequent deaths, navigation struggles, and a final sign-off that redirects the audience to Avaly's channel after Fiona's raid settings reject the host.
